entries.rationale: Spec-text edit with verbatim DDR-1 replacement text and exact regex tests given. One file, single module, purely mechanical prose correction plus a revision-number bump.

Full test code given for the hand-off suite, but the task explicitly authorizes fixing any real gap in Tasks 2-7 it uncovers — an open-ended verification/discovery scope, not pure test authoring. Depends on five prior tasks landing first.

Full implementation, API contract, and tests given nearly verbatim in the plan (DDR-2/3/4/7). Follows the established materialize/drift/reviewers sub-verb dispatch pattern in lib/cli/governance.mjs. Spans lib/governance and lib/cli plus two test dirs, so blast radius is moderate rather than minimal.

Reworks Step 7d.0 prose to an explicit inclusion checklist, reusing Step 7d.1's existing checklist UI shape per DDR-1. Behavior and tests are explicit, but no golden sample exists for this class of skill-prose rework, and it depends on Task 2 landing first.

Reverses Step 7c's zero-selection no-write behavior into an always-write path (BEH-3) — a semantic flip on existing prose that a subagent could easily under- or over-apply. Reuses the existing [d]/[c]/[p]/[s] prompt shape but the write-gate change needs a careful read of surrounding context.
Exact predicate (`enabled !== false`), exact wording (DDR-6), and full test code are all given. Touches two files in one module (review) with no boundary crossing.
Mirrors Task 5's fully-specified warning pattern for the validate registry, with the absent-vs-empty distinction spelled out explicitly. Two files, one module (validation), no boundary crossing.

Two edits (baseline-source change plus surfacing discarded overlay warnings in the Step 7 summary) touching two sections of the same file. The summary-template extension is only sketched, not spelled out verbatim, and misapplying either edit would silently reintroduce the full-bundle baseline bug BEH-6 exists to close.

Four stale-claim corrections, each with exact old/new text and line numbers given. Purely mechanical prose correction, but spans three distinct areas (skill, docs, charter) so blast radius is moderate.
Exact Postcondition and template-header substitutions given verbatim with matching tests. Mechanical text reconciliation spanning one spec and four template files.
